SELECT SOURCE_CD AS SOURCE_CD, OBJECT_ID AS OBJECT_ID, OBJECT_NAME AS OBJECT_NAME, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE FROM V_IF_EOL_RISK E WHERE 1=1
AND (UPPER(NVL(OBJECT_ID,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(NVL(ASSET_ID,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(NVL(OBJECT_NAME,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{keyword})||'%')
ORDER BY EOL_DATE ASC

SELECT R.RESULT_ID AS RESULT_ID, R.GATE_ID AS GATE_ID, D.NAME_KO AS GATE_NAME, R.TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, R.TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, R.RESULT_CD AS RESULT_CD, R.REMARK AS REMARK, R.CHECKED_AT AS CHECKED_AT FROM TB_IF_GATE_RESULT_PILOT R JOIN TB_IF_GATE_DEF_PILOT D ON D.GATE_ID = R.GATE_ID WHERE R.RESULT_CD IN ('FAIL', 'CONDITIONAL')
AND (UPPER(NVL(R.TARGET_ID,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(NVL(R.GATE_ID,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{keyword})||'%')
ORDER BY CASE R.RESULT_CD WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, R.GATE_ID, R.TARGET_ID
